reference: She has scored three penalties this season and she has missed none.
sk: Túto sezónu premenila tri penalty a ani jednu nezahodila.
cz: Tuhle sezonu proměnila tři penalty a ani jednu nezahodila.
acceptable: She has {scored|converted} three penalties this season and {she has missed none|has missed none|she hasn't missed any|hasn't missed any|she hasn't missed a single one|hasn't missed a single one|she hasn't missed one|hasn't missed one}.

This season she has {scored|converted} three penalties and {she has missed none|has missed none|she hasn't missed any|hasn't missed any|she hasn't missed a single one|hasn't missed a single one|she hasn't missed one|hasn't missed one}.

mistakes.text: She scored three penalties this season and {she missed none|she didn't miss any}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Obdobie „this season“ ešte neskončilo, preto je lepší Present Perfect: „has scored“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Období „this season“ ještě neskončilo, proto je lepší Present Perfect: „has scored“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “this season” is not over yet, so Present Perfect is better: “has scored”.

mistakes.text: She has been scoring three penalties this season and she has missed none.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri počte hotových dejov („three penalties“) patrí Present Perfect Simple: „has scored“, nie „has been scoring“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U počtu hotových dějů („three penalties“) patří Present Perfect Simple: „has scored“, ne „has been scoring“.
mistakes.feedback_en: When you count finished actions (“three penalties”), use Present Perfect Simple: “has scored”, not “has been scoring”.

mistakes.text: She has scored three penalties this season and she {hasn't missed none|has not missed none}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V angličtine je len jeden zápor: „hasn't missed any“ alebo „has missed none“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V angličtině je jen jeden zápor: „hasn't missed any“ nebo „has missed none“.
mistakes.feedback_en: English uses only one negative: “hasn't missed any” or “has missed none”.

mistakes.text: She have scored three penalties this season and she has missed none.
